common.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
privacy.title: Send text to the AI service?
privacy.message: The assistant sends your request to {provider} at {host} (model {model}), set up by your administrator.
privacy.message_own: The assistant sends your request to {provider} at {host} (model {model}) with your own key.
privacy.always: With it go the text you work on, your name, addresses and signature, your time zone and the time, the names of the app and your mail server, your standing instructions and the earlier messages of this chat.
privacy.actions: When it does something for you, it also sends what happened and the names of your folders.
privacy.until_asked: Nothing is sent until you ask.
panel.empty.none_plain: Open a message to work on it, or ask anything.
error.not_configured: The AI assistant isn't set up yet. Ask your administrator to add an AI service.
error.bad_key: The AI service didn't accept the API key. It may be wrong or expired.
error.forbidden: The API key isn't allowed to use this model or service.
error.not_found: The AI service doesn't know this model or address. Check the model name in the settings.
error.rate_limit: The AI service is getting too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.rate_limit_wait: The AI service is getting too many requests. You can try again in {seconds} s.
error.rate_limit_now: The AI service is getting too many requests. You can try again now.
error.quota: The AI account has no credit or quota left.
error.busy: The AI service is overloaded right now. Try again in a little while.
error.timeout: The AI service took too long to answer.
error.too_long: The text is too long for this model.
error.bad_request: The AI service refused the request.
error.blocked: The server blocks the address of the AI service. Ask your administrator.
error.unreachable: Could not reach the AI service.
error.server: The AI service had a problem. Try again later.
error.empty: The AI service sent an empty answer.
settings.status_admin: Uses {provider} at {host}, model {model}, set up by your administrator.
settings.status_own: Uses {provider} at {host}, model {model}, with your own key.
settings.not_set_up: Not set up yet. Your administrator has to add an AI service first.
settings.not_set_up_own: Not set up yet. Connect your own API key below, or ask your administrator to add an AI service.
settings.privacy: Nothing goes to the AI service until you ask the assistant something. Before the first request you see where it goes and what is sent, and are asked to confirm.
settings.model_hint: Leave empty to use the default model.
settings.show_in_reader: Show the assistant next to messages
settings.own_hint: Use your own account with an AI service instead. The key is stored encrypted on the webmail server and is only sent to the address below.
settings.bad_url: Enter an address starting with https://
composer.title: AI assistant
composer.prompt_placeholder: What should the email say? For example: thank Anna and propose Tuesday at 10
assistant.scope_selection: Works on the text you selected:
assistant.scope_body: Works on your whole message, without the signature and the quoted email:
assistant.empty_hint: Your message is still empty. Describe what it should say and the assistant writes it.
assistant.instruction_placeholder: For example: add that I'm away next week
assistant.apply_failed: The assistant couldn't change your message. If the selection includes the signature or the quoted email, select only your own text.
assistant.composer_gone: This message isn't open any more.
reader.reply_failed: Couldn't open the reply. Open the message and try again.
reader.nothing_to_do: Nothing to do and no dates in this message.
reader.tasks_hint: Paste it into your tasks, or use Make task if you have the Email to task plugin.
thread.title: Conversation summary ({count} messages)
panel.not_set_up: The assistant is not set up yet.
panel.not_set_up_hint: An administrator adds an AI service in the plugin's settings. Nothing is sent anywhere until you ask.
panel.storage_full: The assistant's storage is full. Start a new chat to free space.
panel.empty.compose: Pick an action from the Actions menu, or say what to change. Highlight text in the message to work on that part only.
panel.empty.write: Describe the email and the assistant writes it. You can insert it and keep editing.
panel.empty.read: Pick an action from the Actions menu, or ask about this message. Highlight a passage to ask about that part.
panel.example_1: Thank Anna for the offer and propose a call on Tuesday at 10
panel.example_2: Decline the invitation politely and suggest next month instead
panel.example_3: Ask for a corrected invoice: the VAT number is missing
panel.placeholder.compose: Say what to change, or ask a question…
panel.placeholder.write: Describe what the email should say…
panel.enter_hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line
panel.open_failed: The message could not be opened in the composer.
panel.step.read_original_message: Read the message you reply to
settings.show_in_reader_hint: The panel beside an open message, and the bar above it on phones.
settings.lookups: Let the assistant look things up
settings.lookups_hint: When an answer needs it: your calendar, your contacts and the message you reply to. Each lookup is shown in the chat.
privacy.lookups: When it looks things up for you, it also sends what it finds: messages from a mail search, calendar events, contacts and your settings.
settings.instructions_hint: Added to every request, so the assistant knows how you like things done.
settings.instructions_example: For example: I am a teacher; write in Swiss German spelling; keep my emails short and warm; sign off with "Herzliche Grüsse, Anna".
widget.read_prompt: Read the message "{subject}" (id {id}) and summarise it.
panel.step.read_message: Read a message from your mail
panel.steps.title: Looked up
panel.placeholder.none: Ask anything, or search your mail…
panel.empty.none: Open a message to work on it, or ask anything: the assistant can search your mail, calendar and contacts.
settings.actions_hint: Let the assistant archive, move and mark messages, add events, tasks and contacts, and open replies for you. Ask me first shows each action for your OK; Automatic does it right away, with Undo. It never sends or deletes mail.
action.draft_reply: Open a reply to “{subject}” with the drafted text
action.draft_reply_all: Open a reply to all for “{subject}” with the drafted text
action.reason.gone: The message isn't there any more.
shortcut.toggle: Open or close the AI assistant
